claims.claim: 14-3-3 proteins bind phosphoserine motifs; mode I consensus R-S-X-pS-X-P, mode II R-X-[Y/F]-X-pS-X-P; the phosphopeptide lies in the amphipathic groove of each monomer in extended conformation
14-3-3 is a cup-shaped dimer; each monomer has its own peptide-binding groove; dimer interface formed by N-terminal helices
claims.source: Liu et al. 1995 Nature, PMID 7603574 (14-3-3 zeta crystal structure)

claims.claim: The phosphate is coordinated by a conserved basic pocket: zeta K49, R56, R127, Y128 -> in 14-3-3 gamma native K50, R57, R132, Y133 = input chain B K49, R56, R131, Y132 (residue identities checked against FASTA)
claims.source: Yaffe 1997 PMID 9428519; many 14-3-3 gamma:phosphopeptide structures e.g. 2B05, 6A5S, 6GKG

claims.claim: LARP1 S548 is an annotated phosphoserine (large-scale phosphoproteomics); peptide PKGLSApSLPDL fits pS-X-P (S548-L549-P550) with R/K upstream at -5 not -3 (G545 at -3, L544 at -4); S546 (S-A-S) does not fit pS-X-P
claims.source: UniProt Q6PKG0 modified-residue feature; motif from PMID 9428519

claims.claim: LARP1 is an mTORC1 substrate controlling 5'TOP mRNA translation; recent cryo-EM 9T76/9T77/9T7A/9T7B show LARP1 TOS/XTOS motif bound to mTORC1 (RAPTOR), a different region from 542-552
claims.source: RCSB 9T76-9T7B titles, 'mTORC1 recruits substrates via an expanded TOS (XTOS) motif' (2026)

not_known: No paper or structure found on the 14-3-3:LARP1 complex itself (Europe PMC 'LARP1 14-3-3' 50 hits, none on the complex; one web search). The FASTA names no modification; the CASP description text was not available to this step - if it says phosphopeptide, the pSer is S7. Whether one or two peptides bind the 14-3-3 dimer in the experiment is not known; given stoichiometry A1B1.
